description: Each case uses a fresh in-memory database. Execute setup then case setup; pass statements and context to readDependencies. Compare sorted tables, null for unsupported, or a thrown error when error is true. The adapter must not execute supplied statements or modify persistent data. Context asserts TEMP tables created by trusted core, never schema names inferred from user SQL.
setup: CREATE TABLE items(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id TEXT, body TEXT)
CREATE TABLE parents(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, enabled INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE history(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE provenance(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE VIEW enabled_parents AS SELECT id FROM parents WHERE enabled=1
INSERT INTO items(id,body) VALUES ('one','[]')
CREATE TEMP TABLE _core_write_before AS SELECT * FROM main.items WHERE 0

statements.sql: SELECT id FROM "items" WHERE body != 'history' /* provenance */
SELECT items.id FROM items JOIN parents ON parents.id=items.parent_id
SELECT id FROM items WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parents)
SELECT id FROM items WHERE parent_id IN (SELECT id FROM parents WHERE enabled>0)
SELECT id FROM items WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM history)
SELECT i.id FROM items i,json_each(i.body) j WHERE j.value IN (SELECT id FROM parents)

cases.name: physical JSON name is not an iterator exemption
setup: CREATE TABLE json_each(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

statements.sql: WITH selected AS (SELECT id FROM parents) SELECT id FROM selected
WITH unknown_context AS (VALUES(1),(2)) SELECT count(*) FROM unknown_context

WITH changed AS (SELECT * FROM main.items WHERE id=? EXCEPT SELECT * FROM temp._core_write_before), before AS (SELECT * FROM temp._core_write_before WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM changed)), now AS (SELECT ? AS ts) SELECT * FROM (SELECT id FROM changed WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM before)>1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM changed)>1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM now)!=1) LIMIT 1

cases.name: physical context name is not an exemption
setup: CREATE TABLE main.before(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

cases.name: unowned TEMP object
setup: CREATE TEMP TABLE unrelated(id TEXT)

cases.name: spoofed physical changed
setup: CREATE TEMP TABLE changed(id TEXT)

cases.name: spoofed physical before
setup: CREATE TEMP VIEW before AS SELECT id FROM parents

cases.name: main and owned TEMP collision
setup: CREATE TABLE main._core_write_before(id TEXT)

cases.name: attached schema
setup: ATTACH ':memory:' AS other
CREATE TABLE other.rows(id TEXT)

cases.name: local bookkeeping
setup: CREATE TABLE _core_state(key TEXT,value TEXT)

cases.name: sync bookkeeping
setup: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS main._sync_state
CREATE TABLE main._sync_state(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT)

cases.name: schema bookkeeping
setup: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS main._schema_log
CREATE TABLE main._schema_log(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,ddl TEXT)

cases.name: missing owned snapshot
setup: DROP TABLE temp._core_write_before

cases.name: owned name is not a view
setup: DROP TABLE temp._core_write_before
CREATE TEMP VIEW _core_write_before AS SELECT * FROM items

statements.sql: SELECT id FROM items; DELETE FROM items

cases.name: virtual table
setup: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE docs USING fts5(body)

cases.name: shadow table
setup: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE docs USING fts5(body)
